related_questions.question: What is the best antiviral drug for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: Paxlovid, an oral antiviral pill that can be taken at home, is the go-to treatment for COVID-19. If you are at high risk for severe disease from COVID, and you take it within the first five days of experiencing symptoms, it will lower your risk of getting so sick that you need to be hospitalized.

related_questions.question: What is the name of the drug that helps with COVID-19?
related_questions.snippet: Both Paxlovid and Lagevrio must be started within the first five days of symptom onset. A third antiviral treatment called Remdesivir is FDA approved for people diagnosed with COVID-19. This is an intravenous treatment that is available at some health care facilities.

related_questions.question: Is Paxlovid still being given for COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, Paxlovid is still a commonly used and recommended treatment for COVID-19, particularly for individuals at high risk of severe illness. It's an oral antiviral medication that can be taken at home and has been shown to reduce the risk of hospitalization and death.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, Paxlovid is still a commonly used and recommended treatment for COVID-19

list.title: Effectiveness:
list.snippet: Paxlovid is highly effective in reducing the severity of COVID-19 when taken within the first five days of symptom onset for those at high risk.

list.title: Full FDA Approval:
list.snippet: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov) granted full approval for Paxlovid in May 2023 for adults with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 who are at high risk of severe illness.

list.title: Emergency Use Authorization:
list.snippet: An Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) also remains in place for adolescents and teens (12 and older) with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 who are at high risk.

list.title: Availability:
list.snippet: Paxlovid is readily available, with options for those with insurance and patient assistance programs for those who are uninsured or underinsured.

list.title: Treatment Considerations:
list.snippet: While Paxlovid is a valuable treatment, it's not suitable for everyone. Your healthcare provider can assess your individual situation and determine if it's the right choice for you based on your symptoms, medical history, and current medications.
